schema:additionalType: Inductively coupled plasma - optical emission spectrometry
schema:description: This dataset shows the chemical composition of Bennu aggregate sample OREX-803047-0 and Orgueil CI chondrite that were dissolved for cosmogenic radionuclide analysis. A small aliquot (~5%) of each of the dissolved samples was taken for chemical analysis by ICP-OES.

schema:distribution.schema:description: this data product is distributed in zip archive; contents of the archive are listed as parts. The component files are not individually accessible

schema:hasPart.schema:description: Raw ICP-OES Data for ORX-8 thru ORX-10, blanks and standards. The data includes measured concentrations (in ppm) for individual spectral lines of each element.
